==English== {{phrasebook|en|Greetings}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|how're you||informal}} * {{alt|en|HRU||initialism}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/haʊ ˈɑː juː/|a=RP}} * {{IPA|en|/haʊ ˈɑɹ ju/|a=GA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-how_are_you.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/hæɔ ˈaː jʉː/|/- jə/|a=AU}} ** {{audio|en|en-au-how_are_you.ogg|a=AU}} ===Phrase=== {{en-head|phr|head=?}} # {{lb|en|idiomatic}} An informal greeting, not requiring a literal response. In form a question, and thus followed by a question mark. Typical responses include: #: {{ux|en|I'm very well, thank you. '''How are you'''? ''(formal)''
[[I'm fine, thank you]]. ''/''
Fine, thanks. ''(informal) /''
Fine, and you? ''(informal)''}} # {{lb|en|idiomatic|Ireland}} (Following a noun phrase; stress on ''are'') An expression of derision, that the preceding referent is unworthy of the name. In form of an exclamation, and thus often followed by an exclamation mark. ====Synonyms==== * ''(formal greeting)'' ** {{l|en|how do you do}}? * ''(informal greeting)'' ** {{l|en|how are you doing}}? ** {{l|en|how's it going}}?, [[how's things]]?, [[how's tricks]]?, [[what's up]]? {{qualifier|more informal}} ** {{l|en|how's it hanging}}? {{qualifier|slang}} ** See also [[Thesaurus:how are you]] * ''(expression of derision)'' ** {{l|en|my foot}}!, {{l|en|my eye}}!, {{l|en|my arse}}!, {{l|en|my ass}}! ** {{l|en|indeed}}! ====Translations==== {{trans-top-see|greeting|how's it going|how}} *
